notes.notes:

Update 1.1.0 Notes[hr][/hr]
⭐News:

Decoration system with new decorative structures to create,

New UI panels for Production and Gathering buildings,

New UI panels for Cooking, Alchemy, and Smelting stations,



🛠️Fixes:

Fixed inaccessible settler action points,

Improved interaction prioritization (fields should no longer block resource pickup),

Fixed issue with warrior equipment being removed after job reassignment,

Improved functionality of menu shortcuts,

Fixed activation of sprint effect,

Improved visibility of destruction effects for Peat and Clay deposits,

Improved female animation sets,

Improved settler pathfinding,

Fixed efficiency calculation in work buildings,

Fixed issue where animals couldn’t be attacked if hiding in bushes,

Improved save load stability,

Quality-of-life improvements to the interaction UI

notes.title: Jarl's Guide #3 - Prologue version of the game and the Building System
notes.notes:
Greetings, mighty Vikings! ✊
[hr][/hr]
Although the title of Jarl is eminently honorable, it comes with great responsibility. Know that managing your own settlement 👑 is a difficult endeavor fraught with hardships, meaningful decisions, and deadly threats. Your life and that of your tribemates can be brought to an abrupt end by harsh weather, famine, cold, untamed wildlife or ferocious animals… and the list goes on. Fear not, however, as the wisdom of the sages and numerous valuable tips are coming to your aid.

This series - The Jarl’s Guide - will help you understand the wild, harsh world around you and support you in your difficult efforts 📜 Read on, and discover how to deal with various unpredictable situations and how to go down in history as a glorious, respectable Jarl. Valhalla!


But before we get to the Building System, let us invite you to Wishlist the ➡️ Viking Frontiers Prologue! ⬅️
[hr][/hr]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/10a61bb87cea1bcdeba5cc1dae7eb7fbd8a5129f.png

The Prologue is another very important step towards the release of Viking Frontiers in its full version, and that is why we hope you will join us in this awesome event. As you know, we deeply appreciate your feedback, opinions, and reviews, recognizing them as indispensable tools for refining and enhancing our titles. The Demo version, despite the fact that it was not completely free of problems, was enthusiastically and warmly received by players around the world 😍 and we aim to repeat this situation again!

Viking Frontiers Prologue will be much richer in content than the mentioned Demo, and will include almost all the mechanics that will appear in the full version of the game, although in their slightly truncated, work-in-progress form. Thus, you will face many new challenges, as well as numerous difficult decisions, new management options and features you have never seen before in our title.

If you'd like to learn a little more about the Prologue version and add it to your Steam Wishlist ✅ be sure to visit this dedicated Steam Page » 


Back to the Jarl's Guide and the Building System ⚒️
[hr][/hr]
Now that we've discussed the release Prologue, we can move on to today's subject. The Building System is one of the most basic mechanics you will encounter during your Viking Frontiers adventure. Without the option to construct new buildings and structures, you'll lack the means to provide shelter for yourself and your tribe, initiate the production of vital goods, engage in crafting, or expand your settlement. Make no mistake - in the harsh Nordic lands, it's equivalent to death. That's why the real Jarls are not afraid to take the hammer in their hands and get to work!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/381ad27f2edce3c2361c7e78d557f07f5d57e497.gif


Your people are in need, so let's make haste. Once you decide to place a new building and have chosen a suitable location, select the building option. When you do this, you will see a circular panel where you can choose the building blueprint of your choice 🗺️ Good job! All you have to do now is place it on the construction site (remember to avoid obstacles, such as trees or boulders).

Once the planning phase is completed, the construction phase begins. Before you start your work, however, you must first prepare the appropriate building materials. Depending on the advancement of the building you have chosen, these will be simple resources such as thatch, clay, or smaller stones or more complex materials like boards, boulders and logs, that require prior processing. Once you know what materials the facility you are building requires, take them to the construction site.


With hammer, wood and stone  🔨
[hr][/hr]
It's time to set the hammer in motion! But first things first - the building process is divided into stages and elements. You can think of Stages as pieces that hold the structure together (pillars, walls, roof, etc.) Every construction work begins with them, and they constitute the backbone of the structure you are placing. However, walls and a roof alone are not enough to make the new place useful! 🏗️ This is where the elements come in. The elements include all types of devices, furniture and production stations that we will soon use for work. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/925ed15237c999a375da1f6bc8ac751323885c02.gif


Ok, now it's time for the most fun part. Grab your hammer and hit the white parts of the building to bring them to new life - stage by stage, element by element. When you complete them all, the construction phase is finished and your settlement is able to enjoy a new useful place to live, work, produce or store goods. Remember that there are many different buildings at your disposal, and each of them has its own unique purpose, so it is worth choosing the right strategy and the order in which they are built 🧐

New buildings and their capabilities are the key to survival in these wild lands. As your tribe develops, your settlement will include, for example, a forge, tannery, port, sawmill, cowshed and many, many more! The more subjects under your command and the greater your ambitions, the more advanced workshops, warehouses and structures you will need. This is why every Jarl must be familiar with the Building System and know how to put their hammers to good use! 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/2dab2a4c7d80d9b80141a8edffee9fb4c3b00930.gif


We hope you find the third entry in our series helpful and interesting. Now that you have all the necessary knowledge about the Building System, constructing new structures and planning your next steps as a Jarl, we can only wish you good luck! Ah, one more thing - and this is important 😁 Do not forget to wishlist the Viking Frontiers Prologue version on this Steam Page » 


Thank you, Vikings! Until next time! 🖐️

notes.title: The first Playtest Hotfix is here!
notes.notes:
Greetings, mighty Vikings! ✊
[hr][/hr]
Well, we can say with full confidence that... you did it again! 😁 You responded in great numbers, and thousands of you applied to our first Viking Frontiers Playtest. We are thrilled that our title has sparked so much interest in you all and that you want to try your hand at leading the newborn Viking society. Remember that the Jarl's burden is heavy, and the fate of your people will depend on your decisions and actions... however, let us get back to the point.

Thanks to our own observations and, above all, your awesome feedback, we were able to prepare the first Hotfix for the game (more of them will come soon!) ⚒️ If you want to find out what fixes, improvements, quality of life changes and corrections we have made, be sure to check out the Hotfix Notes down below 👇


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/d1038f96dcb57b49dd01c15ebc41fb1d0b67f7a4.png


What's new in the Hotfix? 🤓
[hr][/hr]
• Incorporated a verification process to ensure that the task has not been previously completed
• Improved animations of Workstation 
• Improved collision and interactivity of Workstations
• Added integrations with Steam. From now on, tabs will open in the Steam overlay, not in the browser
• Added a new UI panel for construction (build interaction)
• Added new key bind options (rotating construction previews)
• Added notification about the button to dump Large Resource
• Fixed the issue of falling to the bottom of the lake
• Improved balance of building schematics and construction elements
• Added an option to lock items in the Radial Menu panel so that they unlock as the tutorial progresses
• Added a button to unlock characters
• Added a number of new icons
• A number of bug fixes related to objects and collisions in the game
• A number of other minor bugs are now fixed


Thank you, testers!
[hr][/hr]
You can share your feedback via our Discord server and the dedicated Playtest Feedback Form. Every, even the shortest, opinion is important to us, so we will greatly appreciate it if you would like to share your feelings about the game!

In case of any questions or ideas, we remain at your disposal on Steam Discussions, Social Media channels and our Discord server. Be sure to drop by!

Thank you, Vikings! Until next time! 🖐️
